notes: Andrew, 2026-11-17: "I want a floating kitchen island. Place on the wall opposite side of wall of where the living room console is (in the kitchen is where I will put it)." Slot: the kitchen face of the 51" wall whose living-room face holds the Decofy console (F-20); taken as the same 51" on the kitchen side, untaped. The kitchen is not measured, so the walkway in front of the piece (F-30: 30" at least, 36" preferred; 42" where it faces the range, sink or fridge, the designer's standard) is unchecked until Andrew tapes from that wall to whatever faces it. Fit: 39 3/8" leaves 11 5/8" of the 51"; 16 7/8" deep, the shallowest read; 35 3/8" tall, counter height. Materials: "Work top: Solid birch, Oil"; frame, legs and drawers solid wood in white acrylic paint; drawer bottoms plywood; wheels solid birch. Two drawers that pull out from both sides, two slatted shelves ("space for 9 bottles on each shelf"), no doors. Two wheels at one end and two legs at the other in its photos, so it stays put until the leg end is lifted. "Solid wood is a natural material that is easy to repair, refinish"; the top wants oil once a year. 4.6 stars (124); the all-birch finish (article 800.359.20, page not opened) shows $179.99 and 4.7 stars (600) on the category page. In stock in IKEA Long Island, NY; home delivery to 11365 offered, its fee not shown on the page; "Return within 365 days for a full refund*"; IKEA assembly service $27.30, minimum $52.00.
